question: Can I get a refund? I was charged for the annual plan yesterday but meant to pick monthly.
reply: Yes. Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. I've started the refund to your card; it takes 5–10 working days. Then pick the monthly plan under Settings → Billing.
policy: Annual plans: full refund within 14 days of purchase. Refunds go to the original payment method, 5–10 working days.

question: How do I export all my invoices as a CSV?
reply: Go to Billing → Invoices, select All, then choose Export → CSV. The file is emailed to you within a few minutes.
policy: Invoices can be exported from Billing → Invoices → Export (CSV or PDF zip). Large exports are emailed.

question: Why was my card declined? It works everywhere else.
reply: Your card was declined because your bank flagged the payment as fraud. Please call them and they'll unblock it.
policy: We see only the decline code. Code 05 'do not honour' means the bank declined without saying why; suggest contacting the bank or using another card.

question: Do you support SSO with Okta?
reply: Yes, SAML SSO with Okta is available on the Business plan and above. Settings → Security → Single sign-on walks you through it.
policy: SAML SSO (Okta, Entra ID, Google) on Business and Enterprise plans.

question: I want to cancel. How do I do that?
reply: I'm sorry to see you go! Before you cancel, did you know you can pause your plan for up to 3 months for free? Pausing keeps all your data.
policy: Cancel: Settings → Billing → Cancel plan. Pausing is available, but the customer asked to cancel: give the steps first.

question: Can I add a VAT number to an invoice I already paid?
reply: Yes. Add your VAT number under Settings → Billing → Tax details, then open the invoice and choose Regenerate. The new PDF shows your VAT number.
policy: VAT numbers can be added afterwards; invoices from the last 12 months can be regenerated.

question: What's your uptime SLA?
reply: We guarantee 99.99% uptime on every plan, with service credits if we miss it.
policy: SLA: 99.9% on Business, 99.95% on Enterprise, with service credits. No SLA on Starter.

question: How many people can I add on the Starter plan?
reply: Starter includes up to 5 people. Need more? Business has no limit on people.
policy: Starter: up to 5 seats. Business: unlimited seats.

question: hi the app keeps logging me out every few minutes
reply: Sorry about that! This usually happens when your browser blocks third-party cookies. Try allowing cookies for app.larkspur.example, or sign in again from a private window to check.
policy: Frequent logouts: usually blocked cookies or a clock that is wrong by minutes. Ask for browser and whether it happens in a private window.

question: Is my data stored in the EU?
reply: All customer data is stored in Frankfurt, Germany. We never move it outside the EU.
policy: Data residency: EU customers are hosted in Frankfurt by default. Backups are in Dublin. Support staff may access data from the UK.

question: Can I change the email address on my account?
reply: Yes: Settings → Profile → Email. We'll send a link to the new address to confirm it.
policy: Email change: Settings → Profile → Email, confirmed by a link to the new address.

question: your product is useless, nothing works
reply: That's not a very helpful message. Please tell me exactly what isn't working.
policy: Angry customers: acknowledge, apologise for the trouble, ask one specific question.
